newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Stockpile cobalt sale result due by March 20.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Stockpile cobalt sale result due by March 20.

text.p: The much-awaited outcome to the sale of U.S. government stockpiled cobalt by negotiated bid will not be available until about March 20, an official said.
"The best and final offers for the material have been called for and are not due until next Wednesday," Robert O'Brien, stockpile deputy administrator said.
On February 20 the stockpile offered 1.1 million pounds of low grade cobalt, containing 97.0 to 98.9 percent metal on a negotiated basis.
"We expect to have a decision not later than March 20," O'Brien said.
Initially the stockpile had expected to conclude the offer by about March 10.
The longer wait will push the outcome closer to the March 31 deadline for bids on 1 million pounds of higher grade cobalt being sold on a sealed bid basis.
